title: UAE (Dubai) Dedicated Capacity SKU design, reservation tiers, and cross-team GTM orchestration
creator: Asha Patel
description: Launch dedicated capacity in the Middle East (UAE - Dubai region): define SKU families, reservation tiers (monthly/annual commits), pricing bands, and a coordinated GTM plan across Sales, Partnerships, Docs, Console, Support, and Legal. Deliverables include SKU catalog, reservation purchase flow in Console, release notes, partner playbook, and initial sales enablement materials.
scope_in_scope:
- SKU definitions for two instance families optimized for inference (A100-equivalent, L40-equivalent).
- Reservation tiers: Pay-as-you-go, 1-month, 12-month with tiered discounts and overage behavior.
- Console UI and API exposures for purchase, migration from hosted to dedicated SKU, and reservation management.
- Release notes and customer-facing documentation.
- Sales enablement deck and partner pricing playbook.
- Basic observability and SLO targets for the region.
scope_out_of_scope:
- On-prem private packages and air-gapped installs.
- New model onboarding or architecture changes to serving runtime.
- Deep marketplace integration with cloud provider billing systems for first release.
success_metrics: % of reserved capacity sold within 60 days of general availability >= 15% of initial pool
Console reservation purchase conversion rate >= 8% for qualified trials
Average 95th percentile latency within SLA for dedicated UAE instances
Zero P0 production incidents during first 30 days of GA
acceptance_criteria: SKU catalog published in Console and API with correct pricing and SKU IDs
Reservation purchase flow tested end-to-end with billing sandbox and documented in release notes
Sales enablement materials (deck, pricing playbook) approved by Commercial lead
Legal sign-off on customer contract language and data residency statements
Support runbook published and support rotation staffed for UAE region
tasks: Finalize instance families and mapping to global SKU taxonomy (with Eng and Infra)
Produce pricing model and discount tiers; run margin simulation and sensitivity analysis
Implement reservation purchase UI in Console and API endpoints for commit tracking
Wire up release_notes/dedicated-uae.md in docs repo and draft external-facing release notes
Coordinate with Legal to finalize T&Cs and data residency language
Create sales enablement playbook and record short demo video
Prepare monitoring dashboards and SLOs for initial fleet; create alerts and escalation paths
Schedule partner briefing with local cloud partner and marketplace onboarding team
rollout_plan: Canary: 1 instance pool, limited customers by invite (week 0-2)
Pilot: expand to 10 customers with sales-assisted onboarding (week 3-6)
GA: public availability with reservations open and marketing enablement (week 7)
Post-GA: 30-day usage review, pricing adjustments if required (week 8-12)

notes: Trade-offs discussed: start with a narrower SKU set to reduce operating complexity versus offering too many granular SKUs. Decided on two families to simplify procurement and initial capacity planning. Fallback policy: if capacity is constrained, customer requests will be routed to compatible global regions with clear messaging in Console. Release notes coordination: Draft internal release notes by 2026-03-20, external-facing notes ready for GA. Ensure marketing copy avoids implying local data center ownership; we will state 'dedicated capacity serving UAE region' per Legal guidance.
